title: Ridgecrest RxSecure Deductible, Out-of-Pocket Threshold and Payment Plan Terms
content:
A member of a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan meets the deductible their plan carries, on the formulary tiers their plan takes it on, before the initial coverage terms apply; catastrophic coverage then begins once their true out-of-pocket spend for the contract year reaches the threshold their plan carries, and from that point their coinsurance on the negotiated price is the catastrophic figure their plan gives.

| Plan | Annual deductible (USD) | Formulary tiers the deductible is taken on | Annual out-of-pocket threshold (USD) | Catastrophic member coinsurance (per cent of the negotiated price) | Medicare prescription payment plan offered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) | 615.0 | tier 1 preferred generic, tier 2 generic, tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | 2100.0 | 0 | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) | 615.0 | tier 2 generic, tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | 2100.0 | 0 | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Select (PDP) | 480.0 | tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | 2100.0 | 0 | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Plus (PDP) | 300.0 | tier 3 preferred brand, tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | 2100.0 | 0 | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Complete (PDP) | 150.0 | tier 4 non-preferred drug, tier 5 specialty | 2100.0 | 0 | yes |
| Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) | 0.0 | none | 2100.0 | 0 | yes |

## The payment plan offered on every plan

Every Ridgecrest RxSecure plan offers the member the election to spread their out-of-pocket drug costs across the remaining months of the contract year instead of paying at the counter. On all six plans the largest monthly instalment under that election is worked out as the annual out-of-pocket threshold less what the member has already paid, divided by the months left in the contract year.

## Points of judgement

- Two plans share the same deductible figure of 615.0 USD but not the same reach: Ridgecrest RxSecure Basic (PDP) takes it on five tiers including tier 1 preferred generic, while Ridgecrest RxSecure Value (PDP) takes it on four and never on tier 1.
- Ridgecrest RxSecure Premier (PDP) is written at a deductible of 0.0 USD and takes it on no tier at all.
- The out-of-pocket threshold of 2100.0 USD and the catastrophic coinsurance of 0 per cent are the same on all six plans, so the point at which catastrophic coverage begins does not move with the plan held; the deductible does.
